blocker_chain_measured.1_double_support_seating_gap: at the entry instant both legs are in stance (duty 0.68) but the tables' 5.8 mm closure residual appears as a 2.96 mm height gap between the left TD heel (-298.84 mm, the seated contact) and the right mid-stance MP head (-295.88 mm): the LOADED leg starts 3 mm in the air. The runtime's require(gap>0) at reset forces this seating -- base_y must clear the lowest point -- so the gap cannot be initialized away; it is a table-level residual the controller must absorb dynamically.
blocker_chain_measured.2_the_drop: the loaded right leg falls ~3 mm (~0.02 s), delivering ~1 J into the hip/trunk (worst ledger 1.33 J).
blocker_chain_measured.3_the_hip_slam: the hip runs from its 0.765 target onto the +1.1 stop (63 deg flexion), absorbing -12.3 J at the cap.
blocker_chain_measured.4_the_knee_collapse: with the hip pinned, gravity collapses the leg: the knee extends at +3.77 rad/s against its -0.93 target (measured at the deadlock).
blocker_chain_measured.5_the_MP_jam: the driving knee stuffs the MP head 0.58 mm under the floor while the heel sits at +5e-10 and the hip is on its wall.
blocker_chain_measured.6_the_deadlock: heel contact + arriving MP + hip stop are geometrically infeasible (the foot would have to compress); every velocity-level projection leaves a residual that re-violates the wall by 36 um per substep; the clamp loop burns 64 iterations and the budget refuses LOUDLY.
